## Before you run this

**Credentials to create in n8n (never stored in this file):**

1. `OpenRouter` - type *Header Auth*. Name: `Authorization`,
   Value: `Bearer <your OPENROUTER_API_KEY>`.
   Select it on the **OpenRouter: summarize** node.
2. `Google Sheets` - type *Google Sheets OAuth2 API*.
   Select it on the **Append to Candidates** node.

**Environment variables (see `.env.example`):**

- `OPENROUTER_MODEL` (default `openai/gpt-4o-mini`)
- `GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` - the spreadsheet id
- `GOOGLE_SHEET_TAB` (default `Candidates`)
- `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false` so `$env` works in expressions

The `Candidates` tab needs this header row:
Candidate Name | Email | Phone | Current Title | Years Exp | Top Skills | Executive Summary
